Prepare and upgrade your units, and HOLD YOUR GROUND!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 7 (Formerly, [[Headache Headquarters]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Metal Toilet''' was a high health enemy that appeared in [[Headache Headquarters]], replacing the [[Normal Boss]]. Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every [[Normal Boss]] modern variant, or with its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It is the first [[Boss]] that the player encounters. It has high health, defense which decreased most forms of damage and is slightly slower than the [[Chad]], making it a quite dangerous enemy. Additionally, when it first spawns it was a [[Boss]] enemy, making it immune to a large number of stalling methods, immune to defense dropping and immune to [[Nuke]]'s fallout damage. ==Appearance== The '''Metal Toilet''' is a dirty white toilet. A head came out of the toilet. The head has pale skin, an afro and a Spanish Mustache that pointed down. It also has a face with white eyes and teeth. ==Headache Headquarters Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *Multiple [[Militant]]s, [[Golden Scout]]s or [[Golden Cowboy]]es are pretty effective against this. **You may still let it get past your defenses, as it has quite high health. In such cases, consumables like the [[Grenade]] or [[AirStrike]] can be useful at clearing it out. *Towers that decrease defense, such as the [[Electroshocker]], [[Cryomancer]], [[Freezer]] and [[Pyromancer]] can be useful against this. **Defense dropping towers that can also slow down the '''Metal Toilet''' can be especially useful, as they can also slow it down, though they will be less effective or completely ineffective for the first '''Metal Toilet''' because of its [[Boss]] immunity. *Later on, high DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] can be quite useful against this. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1MetalToilet.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMetalToilet.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} MetalToiletIconIG.png|'''Metal Toilet''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Metal Toilet''' enemy was inspired by the ''Skibidi Toilet'' series, with the '''Metal Toilet''' being based on the [[w:c:skibidi-toilet:Normal Skibidi Toilet|Normal Skibidi Toilet]]. *The face used by the '''Metal Toilet''' is a face commonly referred to as the ''Roblox Scary Face'', which appears to have originated from a [https://forum.blockland.us/index.php?topic=215170.0 Blockland Mod] made by chrisbot6. *The '''Metal Toilet''' bears a striking resemblance to [[wp:Bob Ross|Bob Ross]], a painter. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2024''' -
